register.labelZh: CRY 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: cry out against 可以用來描述人們公開而強烈地反對不公平規則、有害行為或錯誤決定。；學校、社團、社區或房間即使不能真正叫喊,也可以用 be crying out for 表示迫切需要某事物。；當人物因害怕、痛楚、驚訝或興奮而突然叫喊時,cry out 可以令故事和對話更加生動。；cry out 可以表示抗議、迫切需要或大聲喊出的說話。閱讀完整句子便能判斷所需意思。
register.summaryEn: Cry out against helps you describe people openly and strongly opposing unfair rules, harmful actions or bad decisions. A school, club, neighbourhood or room can be crying out for something even though it cannot literally shout. Cry out can make stories and conversations more lively when someone suddenly shouts because of fear, pain, surprise or excitement. Cry out may describe a protest, an urgent need or words shouted aloud. The full sentence shows which meaning is intended.

Use cry out for when someone strongly demands something or when something is urgently needed. When the exact shouted words are given, place them after cry out: She cried out, ‘Be careful!’
